In the house's previous round, on 31/Aug (BR-08900/2026, fieldwork 28 to 30/Aug, n=2,005), the same pairing came out 46% to 45% for LULA, that is the same two figures with the sides swapped. ⭐ AND IT IS THE THIRD NATIONAL POLL IN A ROW NOT TO HAND THE PAIRING TO THE LEADER, after Quaest of 07/Sep, which gave a tie at 41% to 41%, and Veritá of 06/Sep, which gave 48.5% to 43.1%. The two before them went the other way: Datafolha of 03/Sep, 46% to 44%, and Quaest of 02/Sep, 42% to 41%, both for Lula. 🏷️ THE HOUSE PUBLISHED TWO PROMPTED [FIRST-ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) SCENARIOS AND BOTH ARE CORRECT, which explains why the press reported the runner-up with different figures: 35% in the scenario WITHOUT Pablo Marçal and 34% in the scenario WITH him, with the leader at 39% in both. Pablo Marçal is barred from running and the Superior Electoral Court has until 14/Sep to rule on the presidential candidacies. ⭐ AND THE RUNOFF WITH AUGUSTO CURY IS THE FIGURE THAT STANDS FURTHEST FROM THE BASE: the house puts him numerically ahead of the leader by 45% to 43%, and Quaest of 07/Sep, with fieldwork that all but overlaps, puts the leader ahead in the same pairing by 39% to 35%. REJECTION: Flávio Bolsonaro 50% and Lula 49%, against 55% and 53% measured by Quaest in the same week, that is the two houses agree on the order and differ by 5 and 4 points on the level. GOVERNMENT APPROVAL: 45% approve and 50% disapprove, with 4% giving no answer, and on the management scale 36% excellent or good, 18% fair and 46% poor or terrible. ⚠️ The disapproval matches exactly the 50% Quaest measured on 07/Sep, and approval differs by 2 points. 📅 TODAY'S RELEASE WAS ALREADY IN THE CALENDAR PUBLISHED BY THE PANEL SINCE 03/Sep, with the expected date and the registration number matching what was published. 🏷️ The unprompted scenario released by the house is not in this entry because the panel could not confirm it in two independent sources.
